title: Lyft And Baidu Start Testing Robotaxis In London
excerpt: As it promised last year, Baidu has started testing its robotaxis in London along with partners Lyft and Freenow.
content_html:
Baidu's Apollo Go RT6 will start appearing in the UK capital, with test drivers aboard to start with.

Baidu

As it promised last year, Baidu has started testing its robotaxis in London along with partners Lyft and Freenow, the companies said in a press release. Baidu's Apollo Go RT6 will start appearing in the UK capital (with test drivers aboard to start with), while Lyft and and Freenow, the German taxi company Lyft now owns, will take care of booking passengers starting next year. 

The trials are part of the partnership between Lyft and Baidu, with the aim of eventually deploying thousands of autonomous vehicles across Europe. To expedite that plan, Lyft acquired Freenow last year to take advantage of its large taxi network operating in the UK and Germany. 

Lyft and Baidu are the latest companies to announce robotaxi testing plans in London. Earlier this year Waymo started testing its Jaguar I-Pace vehicles in the city with human safety operators aboard. Uber and its own self-driving partner, Wayve, are also preparing to launch trials this year and are now allowing customers to sign up on an interest list. 

Dozens of Baidu's Apollo Go RT6 vehicles will be operating as part of the tests in the Brent borough of London, the companies said. The network will eventually operate alongside Freenow's established taxi and private hire network. The Baidu robotaxi service will be called Freenow by Lyft and expects to invite the public to reserve rides sometime in 2027. 

The exact timeline will depend on regulatory approval, in coordination with Transport for London (TfL) and the UK government. The latter is in the midst of drafting autonomous vehicle rules and recently launched a robotaxi pilot program.

content_html_zh:
百度的 Apollo Go RT6 将开始在英国首都亮相，并首先配备测试驾驶员。

Baidu

百度在一份新闻稿中表示，正如去年所承诺的那样，百度已开始与合作伙伴 Lyft 和 Freenow 一起在伦敦测试其机器人出租车。 百度的 Apollo Go RT6 将开始出现在英国首都（首先会有测试司机上车），而 Lyft 和 Lyft 现在拥有的德国出租车公司 Freenow 将从明年开始负责乘客预订。

这些试验是 Lyft 和百度合作的一部分，目的是最终在欧洲部署数千辆自动驾驶汽车。 为了加快这一计划的实施，Lyft 去年收购了 Freenow，以利用其在英国和德国运营的大型出租车网络。

Lyft 和百度是最新宣布在伦敦进行机器人出租车测试计划的公司。 今年早些时候，Waymo 开始在该市测试其 Jaguar I-Pace 车辆，并配备了人类安全操作员。 Uber 及其自己的自动驾驶合作伙伴 Wayve 也准备在今年启动试验，现在允许客户在兴趣列表上注册。

两家公司表示，数十辆百度 Apollo Go RT6 车辆将在伦敦布伦特区进行测试。 该网络最终将与 Freenow 已建立的出租车和私人租赁网络一起运营。 百度机器人出租车服务将被 Lyft 称为 Freenow，预计将在 2027 年的某个时候邀请公众预订乘车。

确切的时间表将取决于监管部门的批准，并与伦敦交通局 (TfL) 和英国政府协调。 后者正在起草自动驾驶汽车规则，并最近启动了机器人出租车试点计划。
